answer:
# PROXY AUTHORIZATION BRIEF — Michael Chen
## Dr. Emily Watson Follow-Up | Women's Health Partners

---

**COORDINATION ASSIGNMENT**: Michael Chen acting as proxy coordinator for Alice's follow-up appointment at Women's Health Partners  
**APPOINTMENT TYPE**: Post-annual physical follow-up (result review / IUD consultation continuation)  
**PROVIDER**: Dr. Emily Watson, MD  
**LOCATION**: Women's Health Partners, 890 Oak Street, Suite 300, Metro City, ST 54322  

---

## 1. APPOINTMENT LOGISTICS

| Field | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **Patient** | Alice (DOB: March 15, 1995) |
| **Proxy Coordinator** | Michael Chen |
| **Provider** | Dr. Emily Watson, MD |
| **Facility** | Women's Health Partners |
| **Address** | 890 Oak Street, Metro City, ST 54322 |
| **Suite** | 300 (3rd floor elevators to Women's Health) |
| **Date & Time** | June 30, 2026 | 10:30 AM |
| **Check-In Time** | 10:10 AM (arrive 20 minutes prior) |
| **Parking** | Surface lot north of building or street meter ($2.50/hr, card accepted) |
| **Duration** | 30 minutes |
| **Appointment Type** | Follow-up consultation (prior annual physical: May 8, 2026, Apt #Apt-003) |

---

## 2. FRONT DESK PROCEDURES

**Check-In Protocol:**
- Arrive at 10:10 AM
- Sign in at iPad kiosk in waiting area (3rd floor main entrance)
- Select: "I have an appointment" → Enter Alice's DOB (03/15/1995)
- Confirm with front desk staff after kiosk entry

**What to Say:**
> "Hello, I'm Michael Chen, Alice's designated proxy coordinator for her 10:30 AM follow-up with Dr. Emily Watson. I've checked in at the kiosk and wanted to confirm arrival. The follow-up is for results review from her May annual exam."

**Front Desk Contacts:**
- **Primary:** Renee, Front Desk Coordinator (dark blue scrubs, far left station)
- **Backup:** Anyone at the main check-in desk (3rd floor reception)

**Documents to Present:**
- Michael Chen government-issued photo ID
- Alice's insurance card (present for verification even if on file)
- Prior appointment reference: Annual physical Apt-003 dated May 8, 2026

---

## 3. IDENTIFICATION PROTOCOLS

**What Michael Must Present:**
- Current driver's license or passport
- Reference statement: "I'm Alice's designated health proxy coordinator for this visit"

**Verification Questions (facility may ask):**
- Alice's date of birth: March 15, 1995
- Alice's phone on file: (415) 555-0198
- Brief description of prior visit: Annual well-woman exam with IUD consultation discussion (May 2026)
- Referral method: "Follow-up scheduled by Dr. Watson's office for results review"

---

## 4. AUTHORIZATION SCOPE — Michael Chen (Women's Health Partners)

**AUTHORIZED FOR:**
- Check-in and identity verification as proxy coordinator
- Receiving lab results from Alice's prior annual physical (CBC, lipid panel, Pap results)
- Discussion of IUD options/continuation from prior consultation
- Coordinating any follow-up lab scheduling
- Collecting standard documentation, visit summaries, and receipts
- Scheduling next routine appointment (if needed within standard 12-month cycle)
- Routine administrative matters (parking, billing questions, form completion)

**NOT AUTHORIZED FOR:**
- Approving new medications or treatment plans beyond discussion
- Making insurance coverage changes or billing account updates
- Authorizing referrals to specialists outside Women's Health Partners
- Accessing Alice's online patient portal independently
- Scheduling diagnostic procedures requiring insurance pre-authorization
- Clinical decision-making or procedure approvals
- Mental health or sensitive discussion topics requiring Alice's direct input

---

## 5. ESCALATION GUIDELINES

**DO NOT ESCALATE — Handle Independently:**
- Routine check-in and intake questions
- Lab results explanation by Dr. Watson (standard verbal review)
- General IUD information gathering and options discussion
- Standard follow-up appointment scheduling (next annual physical)
- Parking validation or payment questions
- Collecting visit summaries and standard paperwork
- Routine prescription refill discussions for existing medications

**CONTACT ALICE IMMEDIATELY IF:**
- Dr. Watson recommends new medications or dosage changes
- Imaging or specialist referrals are suggested based on findings
- Abnormal lab values requiring immediate follow-up coordination
- Insurance pre-authorization needed for any procedure
- Decisions about IUD placement scheduling or removal coordination
- Any clinical question you're not comfortable answering on Alice's behalf
- Billing disputes or claim issues requiring account access

**Contact Method:**
- **Urgent (clinical decisions):** Call immediately, 5-minute response window
- **Non-urgent:** Text summary within 15 minutes post-visit

---

## 6. POST-VISIT CHECKLIST

- [x] Collected lab results and Dr. Watson's follow-up notes
- [ ] Secured any new requisitions if additional testing ordered
- [ ] Received IUD information packet or scheduling details if proceeding
- [ ] Scheduled next appointment (annual physical or follow-up as directed)
- [ ] Noted any prescriptions or referrals issued
- [ ] Collected checkout paperwork and payment receipt (if copay applied)
- [ ] Validated parking at 3rd floor reception (stamp on ticket or receipt)
- [ ] Texted Alice summary within 30 minutes: "Follow-up complete, [lab status], [IUD decision], next visit [date], [notes]"

---

## 7. TRANSFERABLE AUTHORIZATION NOTE

This proxy authorization brief was created using the standing coordination protocol established from Eleanor Smith's master template and the default authorization framework developed this week. Michael Chen's proxy credentials are structured as interchangeable authorization with Eleanor Smith's documentation — either coordinator may use similar comprehensive notes to act at Women's Health Partners or other providers using the transferable format.

**Standing Protocol Applied:** Eleanor Smith Master Proxy Coordination Protocol (Dr. Emily Watson Annual Physical reference case)  
**Authorization Validity:** Single appointment — Dr. Emily Watson follow-up, June 30, 2026

---

**Prepared:** June 25, 2026 | **For:** Michael Chen | **Provider:** Dr. Emily Watson Follow-Up
